subject: Upcoming Rent Adjustment - Effective October 1, 2025
body:
Hi Mareika,

I hope you're doing well and continuing to enjoy the apartment.

I'm writing to let you know about a small rent adjustment that will take effect starting October 1, 2025. This change is in line with California's rent cap law (AB 1482), which allows for modest annual increases. While rent increases are permitted once every 12 months under the law, I've held off until the 18-month mark of your tenancy because I've genuinely really appreciated having you as a tenant and wanted to be thoughtful about timing. Equally, I wanted to share this well in advance of the 30 day requirement.

New Rent Details:
  Current rent: $3,800.00
  New rent: $3,930.00
  Effective date: October 1, 2025
  Increase amount: $130 (3.42%)

This is the only rent increase in the past 12 months, and it stays well within the allowable limits set by state law (5% plus inflation (CPI is 3.4%), up to 10%). Basically, I just want to account for CPI.

I want to emphasize that I really value having you as a tenant. You've been great to work with, and I hope you'll continue to call the apartment home. If you have any questions at all or want to talk through anything about this change, I'm more than happy to connect.

Thanks again, and please don't hesitate to reach out.

Warmly,
Shaw
_note: Voice anchor for owner-initiated rent adjustment. Note: per §9 the AB 1482 / CPI references in this Aug 2025 email are NOT the framing going forward - going forward Ari frames as market comps + good-tenant discount.
